status: Seven playable simulator stages installed; Earth car handling retained by user choice.

moon.attribution: Haase et al. (2018), Apollo 17 traverse reconstruction; USGS Astrogeology; LRO/LROC, NASA and Arizona State University. See sources/AAREADME.TXT.
moon.routeAccuracy: Reconstructed cartography; not GPS or a surveyed racing road.
moon.projection: Lunar spherical transverse Mercator for route; lunar equirectangular DEM, latitude of true scale 20 degrees, central meridian 180 degrees.

mars.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech Mars 2020 Rover PLACES, PDS Geosciences Node; terrain NASA/USGS HiRISE Mars 2020 TRN mosaic.
mars.routeAccuracy: Interpolated rover localizations, not wheel-track survey. Sub-5 m movements filtered for the racing corridor; no teleporting or invented links.
mars.projection: Mars 2000 sphere radius 3396190 m, equirectangular standard latitude 0 degrees. Road DEM values, not localization heights, determine race elevation.
mars.selectionReason: Long continuous transit section; ends before a science-stop reversal. Earlier candidate sols 200-400 rejected because repeated corridors produced terrain conflicts.

gameAdaptations: Earth gravity, tires, suspension, powertrain and atmosphere handling unchanged.
8 m fictional racing corridor; gravel is the existing simulator surface approximation, not a calibrated lunar/Martian soil model.
Orbital terrain sampled at 40 m cells; road control elevations sampled directly from DEM. Existing road interpolation and terrain fitting apply.
Small untimed start/finish continuations are authored and identified separately from recorded path.
Rock placement and gray/red gravel art are fictional temporary dressing. Dedicated artwork listed in ai/needed-graphics.txt.
Source data is downloaded offline; playing a saved race does not contact NASA or USGS.
rebuildCommands: Download Mars CSV to artifacts/planetary/m20-best_interp.csv using the mars.routeUrl above

validation.fullRaceLoading: Both planetary races passed; final Mars report has zero unresolved road/terrain height conflicts.
validation.browserValidation: Headless native editor/world-bake tests ran locally; no browser driving session or Playwright execution on Termux.
